d: Bengal Warriorz stormed past Bengaluru Bulls by a 40-29 scoreline in match 44 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Maninder Singh and Nitin Kumar slipped past the defence to score 24 raid points in total while Nitesh Kumar scored 3 tackle points to provide equal assistance on the defensive front. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
